new: Ascension of Isaiah 10:8 — *Go forth and descend through all the heavens, and thou wilt descend to the firmament and that world.* The Father sends the Beloved down through the heavens, and Matthew 1:23 names where the descent ends: *Elohim (God) with us.*

Ascension of Isaiah 9:12 — *Crowns and thrones of glory they do not receive, till the Beloved will descend.* Heaven announces beforehand the Beloved's coming down in human form, and at the water the voice from heaven says, *This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased* (Matthew 3:17).

Ascension of Isaiah 11:32 — *And then I saw Him sit down on the right hand of that Great Glory.* The Son whom the voice from heaven names at the water (Matthew 3:17) is seen here with his journey down and back up finished, seated beside the Great Glory.

Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs 3:1 — *an eighth spirit of sleep, with which is brought about the trance of nature and the image of death.* Reuben lists the spirits that work in a man through his nature and his senses, and Yahusha (Jesus) puts the sin in the same place when he says that whoever looks on a woman to lust after her *hath committed adultery with her already in his heart* (Matthew 5:28).
flag: The card sits on Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs 3:1, which in the live text is the eighth spirit of sleep; the spirit of fornication the old note quotes belongs to the following verse. Member note quotes the verse the card sits on and keeps the heart-seated point.

new: Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs 64:7 — *Jacob, my father, knew that Elohim (God) aided my singleness.* Issachar's single heart is an open hand toward the poor, and Yahusha (Jesus) says, *if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light* (Matthew 6:22).
